title: Kyoto State Guest House Main Gate
geometryBasis: The documented ceremonial gate uses the mapped west entrance roof outline and neighboring wall turns. Dimensions above grade are estimated from the verified entrance photograph.
sectionBasis: Abasaa’s exact photograph establishes the single gently curved dark-gray tiled roof, unpainted dark main posts and doors, narrow open upper lattice, exposed off-white rafter ends, ochre plaster wings and pale stone apron.
limitations: Represents the formal outer view of the publicly photographed gate and its immediate plaster wings. The rest of the guesthouse precinct and interiors are outside model scope.
Rafter profile, rear joinery, wall apron courses and measured heights are representative estimates.
